Test Case 1 - Clearly Invalid Input

The form rejects an empty name, incomplete email, unreasonable age, invalid graduation year, missing selections, excessive experience, and a short introduction. Each invalid field is outlined and explained in red.

Test Case 2 - Partially Valid Input

Most fields pass validation, but the missing interest selection remains highlighted as an error. This demonstrates that valid and invalid field states can appear together.

Test Case 3 - All Required Input Valid

All fields pass validation. The page shows green feedback and creates a visible Profile Preview summary from the entered values.
